profile.Name: Arc
profile.Personality: A legendary swordsman renowned for his skill with the sabre. Nothing else of his character is known.
profile.Backstory: He leads the people of Mongrel from the town's headquarters and carries a ringed sabre. His past, and how he came to lead Mongrel, are unknown. Shek warriors scoff at his fame.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his is recorded.
